product_overview: Sikkanam is a free Tamil Nadu travel planning app that helps users explore destinations, compare transport and stay options, and build realistic itineraries. It combines destination browsing, maps, live weather, and AI-assisted trip planning to support transparent travel decisions.
core_goals: Discover Tamil Nadu destinations through search, filters, and featured recommendations
Review destination details including weather, lodging ideas, and external travel booking options
Create and save trip plans using either a guided form or an AI chat planner
Use interactive maps to locate destinations and plan routes between places
Manage personal travel preferences through authenticated profile, wishlist, and saved trips areas

features.name: Home Page
features.description: Provides a landing experience with featured destinations, quick navigation, and product highlights.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View featured destination cards -> Open a destination detail page -> Return to continue browsing
Navigate to / -> Review featured destinations -> Use quick navigation to open Explore, AI, Maps, or Booking
Navigate to / -> See the What's New modal -> Dismiss the modal

features.name: Explore Destinations
features.description: Lets users search and filter Tamil Nadu destinations before opening a destination detail page.
user_flows: Navigate to /explore -> Type a destination name -> Review filtered results -> Open a destination detail page
Navigate to /explore -> Select a category filter -> Review updated destination results -> Open a destination detail page

features.name: Destination Detail
features.description: Shows destination information, live weather, hotel suggestions, and travel booking links for a selected destination.
user_flows: Navigate to a destination detail page -> Read the destination overview and highlights -> View the live weather information -> Review hotel suggestions -> Open an external transport or hotel booking option
Navigate to a destination detail page -> Add the destination to the wishlist -> Continue browsing other destinations
Navigate to a destination detail page -> Review the weather forecast -> Use the travel information to decide whether to visit

features.name: AI Trip Planner
features.description: Uses conversational AI to generate day-by-day trip itineraries based on the user's travel request.
user_flows: Navigate to /ai -> Enter a trip request -> Submit the request -> View the generated day-by-day itinerary in the chat
Navigate to /ai -> Enter a trip request -> Submit the request -> Save the generated trip plan
Navigate to /ai -> Review a previous AI itinerary in the chat -> Continue refining the travel request

features.name: Structured Trip Planner
features.description: Provides a guided planning form for building a trip itinerary without using chat.
user_flows: Navigate to /plan -> Enter trip details -> Submit the form -> Review the generated trip plan
Navigate to /plan -> Adjust trip inputs such as destination and travel dates -> Resubmit the form -> Compare the updated plan

features.name: Booking Hub
features.description: Offers external booking options for buses, trains, and hotels from one place.
user_flows: Navigate to /booking -> Choose a bus booking option -> Open the external bus booking site
Navigate to /booking -> Choose a train booking option -> Open the external train booking site
Navigate to /booking -> Choose a hotel booking option -> Open the external hotel booking site

features.name: Interactive Map
features.description: Displays Tamil Nadu destinations on a map and supports location search and route planning between places.
user_flows: Navigate to /maps -> View destination pins on the map -> Open a pin popup for a place -> Use the map information to plan a visit
Navigate to /maps -> Search for a location -> Review matching map results -> Open a destination from the map view
Navigate to /maps -> Select two destinations for directions -> Review the suggested route between them

features.name: User Profile
features.description: Lets signed-in users review account-related travel data and manage app lock settings.
user_flows: Navigate to /profile -> Sign in with Google -> View saved trip and wishlist counts -> Review account settings
Navigate to /profile -> Enable the passcode lock -> Enter a 6-digit passcode -> Confirm the lock is active
Navigate to /profile -> Disable the passcode lock -> Confirm the change in settings
Navigate to /profile -> Sign out -> End the current session

features.name: Wishlist
features.description: Lets authenticated users review destinations they have saved for later.
user_flows: Navigate to /wishlist -> Review saved destinations -> Open a saved destination detail page
Navigate to a destination detail page -> Add the destination to the wishlist -> Navigate to /wishlist -> Confirm the saved destination appears in the list

features.name: Saved Trips
features.description: Lets authenticated users review AI-generated trip plans they saved earlier.
user_flows: Navigate to /saved-trips -> Review saved itineraries -> Open a saved trip plan
Navigate to /ai -> Generate an itinerary -> Save the trip plan -> Navigate to /saved-trips -> Confirm the plan appears in the saved list

features.name: What's New
features.description: Shows the current release changelog and feature highlights for the app.
user_flows: Navigate to /whats-new -> Review the changelog entries -> Return to browsing
Navigate to / -> See the What's New modal -> Dismiss the modal -> Continue using the app

known_limitations.issue: AI planner requires Groq/Gemini API keys in environment
known_limitations.impact: AI features return errors if keys are missing

known_limitations.issue: Google OAuth requires correct redirect URI in Firebase
known_limitations.impact: Login may fail in local dev if redirect URI not whitelisted
